nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: Entry point, calls SuricataMainLoop

nodes.label: SuricataMainLoop
nodes.desc: Config, rules load, then RunModeDispatch

nodes.label: RunModeDispatch
nodes.desc: Runs mode handler, spawns flow manager/recycler/stats threads

nodes.label: RunModeSetLiveCaptureWorkers
nodes.desc: Workers runmode entry, one thread per configured queue

nodes.label: RunModeSetLiveCaptureWorkersForDevice
nodes.desc: Creates W#NN-dev threads, appends Receive/Decode/FlowWorker/RespondReject slots

nodes.label: TmThreadsSlotPktAcqLoop
nodes.desc: Worker thread body: loops the acquisition function

nodes.label: TmThreadsSlotVarRun
nodes.desc: Walks slot_next chain, runs each module inline on the packet

nodes.label: TmThreadsSlotProcessPkt
nodes.desc: Inline packet pass to the slot chain, no queue hop

nodes.label: thread_pkt_pool
nodes.desc: thread_local packet pool, return_threshold 32, avoids allocator contention

nodes.label: ReceiveAFPLoop
nodes.desc: AF_PACKET ring poll loop, V2/V3 TPACKET read

nodes.label: DecodeAFP
nodes.desc: Decode slot: DecodeLinkLayer by datalink type

nodes.label: DecodeEthernet
nodes.desc: Ethernet parse, dispatches DecodeNetworkLayer by ethertype

nodes.label: DecodeIPV4
nodes.desc: IPv4 header, protocol chain to TCP/UDP

nodes.label: FlowWorker
nodes.desc: Fused slot: flow, stream, app-layer, detect, output

nodes.label: FlowHandlePacket
nodes.desc: Flow setup/update when PKT_WANTS_FLOW

nodes.label: FlowGetFlowFromHash
nodes.desc: hash % flow_config.hash_size bucket lookup, flow returned locked

nodes.label: FlowWorkerStreamTCPUpdate
nodes.desc: TCP reassembly and app-layer update on the flow

nodes.label: Detect
nodes.desc: Detection entry, picks DetectFlow or DetectNoFlow

nodes.label: DetectFlow
nodes.desc: Per-flow inspect path: prefilter then rule inspection

nodes.label: DetectRunPrefilterPkt
nodes.desc: PacketCreateMask then Prefilter, dedups candidate sids

nodes.label: Prefilter
nodes.desc: Runs per-sgh engine list, fills det_ctx->pmq

nodes.label: SCHSSearch
nodes.desc: Hyperscan hs_scan with SCHSMatchEvent calling PrefilterAddSids

nodes.label: SCACSearch
nodes.desc: Built-in Aho-Corasick queue matcher, fallback when no Hyperscan

nodes.label: DetectRunInspectRuleHeader
nodes.desc: Cheap proto/port/address header test per candidate rule

nodes.label: DetectEngineContentInspection
nodes.desc: Full content/isdataat/pcre evaluation on candidate rules

nodes.label: AlertQueueAppendPacket
nodes.desc: Appends matched sid to per-packet alert queue

nodes.label: SigParse
nodes.desc: Parses rule text into Signature + SigMatch lists

nodes.label: RetrieveFPForSig
nodes.desc: Chooses the strongest content as fast-pattern/MPM anchor

nodes.label: SigGroupBuild
nodes.desc: Groups signatures into sgh arrays by proto/port/direction

nodes.label: PrefilterAppendPayloadEngine
nodes.desc: Binds an MPM engine instance to a signature group

nodes.label: PatternMatchThreadPrepare
nodes.desc: Per-thread MPM contexts, clones Hyperscan scratch

nodes.label: OutputLoggerLog
nodes.desc: Per-packet logger dispatch (alert/eve/stats)
